whatsappMessage:
Hi Shahnaz team,

I noticed your salon on Fraser Road has an exceptional 4.9★ rating from 62+ reviews, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new clients.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, service menu, aur client gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/shahnaz

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Shahnaz team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon (Fraser Road, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking and your top-rated service menu for local clients in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
